title: Apify settings
subtitle: Choose the Apify actor behind each platform, how many posts a single call may return, and how long to wait for it.
errorContext: load or save the Apify settings
loadFailed: Unable to load the Apify settings.
saveFailed: Unable to save the Apify settings.
tokenMissing: No Apify API token is configured (APIFY_API_TOKEN in backend/.env), so these actors will not run. Prices below are still shown.
saved: Saved. Applies from the next pipeline run.
readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
note: Changes apply from the next pipeline run. A blank or default value falls back to the built-in setting. Max posts is shared by actors of the same platform where they list the same value.

pricing.saveToSee: Save to see the price of this actor.
pricing.ceiling: Up to {{price}} per call at {{posts}} posts
